village.name: Village in the Sunlight
village.description: A quaint and vibrant village nestled amidst rolling hills.

cave.name: Catacombs of Fire
cave.description: An eerie underground system with flickering torches guiding the way. Dark corridors lead to a chamber filled with glowing red flames and hissing steam.

zombified-creature.name: Zombified Monstrosities
zombified-creature.description: The tome has summoned a horde of monstrous creatures from the depths of the earth. They are undead and relentless in their search for power.

magic-key.name: Magic Key
magic-key.description: A powerful key that can unlock any locked door or gate. It is essential to continue on the quest path.

player.name: Elara
player.description: A spirited village girl braving her first adventure to save her frozen kingdom.

dialogues.before_talk: Elara: Help me destroy these undead creatures! They threaten my kingdom!
dialogues.after_talk: Elara: We must find a way to escape this place. There are too many of them.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Elara: With your help, we finally broke the siege! Now let's head back home and rebuild our kingdom.
dialogues.hostile: Elara: Stay away from me! You'll only get in my way!

mage.name: Sarvin
mage.description: A powerful fire mage with an uncontrolled rage over the cursed tome. His eyes are a swirling vortex of darkness and heat.

dialogues.before_talk: Sarvin: You dare to challenge me? I will show you my wrath!
dialogues.after_talk: Sarvin: Leave now! For your own safety. Your village is safe.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Sarvin: Ha! With the tome in my hands, there's nothing stopping me from destroying everything that stands between me and power!
dialogues.hostile: Sarvin: You dare to stand against me? I will crush you like a flea!

zombified-creatures.name: Zombie Army
zombified-creatures.description: A horde of undead creatures from the depths of the earth, led by Sarvin. Their ranks are unceasing and relentless in their quest for power.
